title: 列車受電弓接觸工程
summary: 由機械支承到電氣接觸，分開平均接觸力、瞬時離線和熱效應。
summaryEn: Move from support mechanics to electrical contact, separating mean force, momentary separation and heating.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 受電接觸力平衡：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pantograph contact-force balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 受電接觸力平衡 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pantograph contact-force balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為受電弓弓頭、導線與接觸時序。簡化靜態平衡不含氣動升力、導線波動及慣性；高速接觸是動態耦合。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows pantograph head, wire and contact traces. Static balance excludes aerodynamic lift, wire waves and inertia; high-speed contact is dynamically coupled.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：Fcontact=Flift-mg；Flift=180 N、m=10 kg；計算結果=81.9 N。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: Fcontact=Flift-mg; Flift=180 N, m=10 kg; result=81.9 N.
steps.failure: 平均接觸力正常仍可能離線；檢查瞬時低值、弧光與位置關聯。
steps.failureEn: A normal mean can coexist with loss of contact; inspect minima, arcing and position.
steps.check: 靜態接觸反力81.9 N；不是列車受電弓設定值。 將此判讀連回受電弓弓頭、導線與接觸時序的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Static contact reaction is 81.9 N, not a pantograph setting. Relate this interpretation to pantograph head, wire and contact traces and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在試算表、紙面剖面或自行準備的離線教學模型中：在示意圖標抬升、重力、接觸與慣性方向，再畫接觸力時間序列。 交付物：本單元計算表、可重現條件與一項尚無法判定的結論。
knowledge.textEn: Using a worksheet, paper section or an offline teaching model you prepare: Mark lift, weight, contact and inertia directions and draw a contact-force time trace. Deliver a calculation sheet, reproducible conditions and one conclusion that the evidence cannot establish.

An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
A correct simplified calculation removes the need to verify the specific boundaries of Train pantograph contact engineering.
quiz.explanation: 本課觀察對象為受電弓弓頭、導線與接觸時序。 靜態接觸反力81.9 N；不是列車受電弓設定值。 將此判讀連回受電弓弓頭、導線與接觸時序的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
